paragraphs.en: Health and {fitness} help a person live a good and healthy life.Often due to various {pressures} , we tend to ignore our health.This makes our {body} suffer and we will catch {diseases} .It is the fitness level of our body that helps us fight these diseases.
paragraphs.cn: 健康和 <u> 健身 </u> 有助于一个人过上健康美好的生活。通常由于各种 <u> 压力 </u> ，我们往往会忽视自己的健康。这会让我们的 <u> 身体 </u> 遭受痛苦，并引发 <u> 疾病 </u> 。正是我们身体的健康水平帮助我们抵抗疾病。

paragraphs.en: Health and fitness are two frequently {discussed} {topics} in the modern world.They are {interrelated} to each other.We need to be fit to have a healthy body.Similarly, if we are healthy, we {shall} {naturally} be {attracted} towards {maintaining} the fitness of our body.Health is the state of our body at a given time.A {genuine} indicator ( (标志) ) of good health might be the absence of disease or {disability} , but we could still have a {weak} body, which is ready to be {targeted} by {viruses} .For {instance} , we may have a tendency to catch a {cold} easily.This does not {definitely} mean that we are not healthy.It means the fitness level is not in {accordance} with our age and the {climatic} {conditions} where we live.
paragraphs.cn: 健康和健身是现代社会人们经常 <u> 讨论 </u> 的两个 <u> 话题 </u> 。它们 <u> 相互关联 </u> 。我们需要保持良好的身体状态才能拥有健康的体魄。同样地，如果我们身体健康，就 <u> 会自然而然地 </u> 被 <u> 吸引 </u> 去 <u> 维持 </u> 身体的良好状态。健康是我们的身体在某一特定时间的状态。健康状况良好的 <u> 真正 </u> 标志或许是没有疾病或 <u> 残疾 </u> ，但我们的身体仍可能很 <u> 虚弱 </u> ，容易成为 <u> 病毒 </u> 攻击的 <u> 目标 </u> 。 <u> 例 </u> 如，我们可能很容易 <u> 感冒 </u> 。这并不 <u> 一定 </u> 意味着我们不健康。这意味着我们的健康水平与我们的年龄及所处的 <u> 气候条件 </u> 不 <u> 符 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: It is important for {everybody} to {devote} some time to health and fitness.There are some activities which everybody should do in their lives.For instance, we should engage in sports like running, cycling, {tennis} or {golf} {regardless} of our age and working style.Regular {gymnastics} is a good choice, and going on a {picnic} or {camping} also creates chances for necessary physical activities.Moreover, maintaining a balanced diet rich in {protein} and taking in nutritious foods like {bananas} and {carrots} can support your health and fitness goals by providing essential vitamins and minerals.
paragraphs.cn: 对 <u> 每个人 </u> 来说，把一些时间 <u> 投入 </u> 到健康和健身上是很重要的。生活中有些活动是人人都应该参与的。例如， <u> 无论 </u> 我们处于什么年龄，工作风格如何，都应该参加像跑步、骑自行车、打 <u> 网球 </u> 或 <u> 高尔夫球 </u> 这样的运动。经常做 <u> 体操 </u> 是一个不错的选择， <u> 野餐 </u> 或 <u> 露营 </u> 也能为必要的体育活动创造机会。此外，保持富含 <u> 蛋白质 </u> 的均衡饮食，摄入 <u> 香蕉 </u> 、 <u> 胡萝卜 </u> 等营养丰富的食物，都能通过提供必需的维生素和矿物质帮助你达到强身健体的目的。

paragraphs.en: {Additionally} , it is important to {relax} our body.While everyone seems to be in a constant {hurry} , we should still have at least six to {eight} hours of {sleep} every day.After all, we wouldn't keep our computers running on low {battery} .Sleep doesn't make us {lazy} .It helps in improving our immune ( (免疫) ) system and protects us against diseases.It also helps in keeping us {calm} and releases {tension} .Otherwise, we become {careless} , making mistakes that could be easily avoided. {Pilots} also need {adequate} sleep to safely navigate through the skies.
paragraphs.cn: <u> 另外 </u> ， <u> 放松 </u> 身体也很重要。虽然每个人似乎都一直处于 <u> 匆匆忙忙 </u> 的状态，但我们仍应每天至少保证六到 <u> 八 </u> 个小时的 <u> 睡眠 </u> 。毕竟，我们不会让电脑在低 <u> 电量 </u> 下运行。睡眠不会让我们变得 <u> 懒惰 </u> 。它有助于增强我们的免疫系统，保护我们免受疾病侵袭。睡眠还有助于我们保持 <u> 冷静 </u> ，释放 <u> 压力 </u> 。否则，我们就会变得 <u> 粗心大意 </u> ，犯下本可轻易避免的错误。就连 <u> 飞行员 </u> 也需要 <u> 充足的 </u> 睡眠才能在天空中安全地航行。
